name: create_calendar_event
description: Add an event to one calendar Surface. Timed timing is {kind:'timed', start, end, timeZone}: start and end are local wall-clock date-times such as 2026-10-20T09:00 in timeZone, an IANA name such as Europe/Berlin (never a bare offset). Use the zone the person means, usually their own. An optional trailing offset must match the zone at that time and picks one instant of a repeated hour; without it, a time skipped by a daylight-saving jump moves forward and a repeated time takes the earlier instant. All-day timing is {kind:'allDay', startDate, endDate} with endDate exclusive: a one-day event on 2026-10-20 has endDate 2026-10-21. Events last at most 366 days. Recurrence is null or {frequency: daily|weekly|monthly|yearly, interval (default 1), weekdays (weekly only: monday…sunday, or null for the start's weekday), until (inclusive YYYY-MM-DD) or count (total occurrences)}; at most one of until and count. The event's own timing is occurrence 0. Monthly and yearly skip months or years without the start's day (31st, 29 February). Times stay at the same wall-clock time across daylight-saving changes. There are no per-occurrence exceptions: every edit changes the whole series. The title may be empty. Explicitly supply authorUserId as a local Happy user ID, or null for no attribution; only null is allowed in standalone mode. The author is immutable and separate from the revision's audit actor. This never joins anyone to the Surface.
